name: Cherkasy

routes.outcome: Official Cherkasy regional StateGeoCadastre cadastral-and-registration page loaded; it describes the State Land Cadastre and cadastral registration.
Official Cherkasy city department page loaded; it identifies the urban-cadastre GIS function and links the municipal geoportal.

Official municipal ArcGIS layer schema loaded. Geometry is polygon; source spatial reference is msk_Cherkassy/Pulkovo 1942 Gauss-Kruger; cdstr_nmbr is the cadastral-number field; objectid/globalid also exist but were not requested.
Exact WUP point query returned an empty GeoJSON FeatureCollection; this was not treated as evidence of absence.

Bounded envelope query with browser headers, outFields=cdstr_nmbr, resultRecordCount=3 and output CRS 4326 returned three full polygon features and exceededTransferLimit=true. Full raw response is kept only under ignored tmp/; retained sample strips all source attributes except canonical id.

schemaAndCrs.localCatalog: Cherkasy municipal ArcGIS Feature Layer 52, Внутрішні території 1:2257
schemaAndCrs.observed: Layer metadata exposes cdstr_nmbr, objectid, globalid and other source fields. Only cdstr_nmbr and geometry were requested for the bounded sample; unsafe owner/address/contact fields were not requested or retained.

qualification.reason: Bounded anonymous ID+geometry response qualifies as research evidence, but serial review must independently assess adapter behavior, completeness, and reuse terms.

scopeLimits: The WUP point is a city locator, not a parcel-coverage test; it returned zero and was not shifted.
The successful envelope is a small local sample and does not prove citywide completeness or countrywide coverage.
The regional StateGeoCadastre is a custodian/procedure source; the verified geometry came from the municipal GIS service.
The response exceeded the three-record limit; no bulk extraction was attempted.
uncertainty: Cherkasy has a verified municipal public polygon service with native cadastral-number identities. Completeness, update cadence, licensing/reuse terms, and adapter admission remain uncertain. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, certificate exception, or unsafe owner/address fields were used.
